identity.label: CosyVoice 3.0
identity.description: Multi-lingual large voice generation model with zero-shot voice cloning, streaming, instruction control, 9+ languages, 18+ Chinese dialects. LLM-based TTS with flow matching.

benchmark.output_quality_notes: State-of-the-art multilingual zero-shot TTS. 150ms streaming latency claimed. Very active development (20.8k stars, 3 major versions). vLLM and TensorRT-LLM deployment support.

blockers: CUDA-only — no MLX, Metal, MPS, or ONNX path exists
0.5B parameters with ~8 GB VRAM — heavy for Apple Silicon unified memory
Requires sox system dependency and heavy Python environment
verdict.notes: CosyVoice is the most impressive of the three for Vox Jot's TTS needs — exceptional multi-lingual coverage, zero-shot voice cloning, streaming, and instruct-mode support. The feature set is arguably best-in-class. However, the entire stack is CUDA-bound. No community effort to port to MLX or MPS exists yet. If an MLX port materializes (the architecture is LLM + flow matching, both of which have MLX precedents), this would jump to a clear 'ship' score of 44+. Worth watching quarterly. The 300M variant could be more feasible for Apple Silicon if ported.
